item.description: March 31, 2026 @ 12:00 am - We have teamed up with Dawn at Fuzzy Love Photography for another charitable coffee table book project and we cannot wait for this one! item.title: Pups on the Pitch
item.description: April 4, 2026 @ 2:30 pm - Join the Humane Society of Utah and Real Salt Lake for a special Pups on the Pitch experience! Don’t miss our adoptable puppies with the starting lineup for an unforgettable day at the stadium celebrating soccer, community, and our shared love of animals.

item.title: Bark at the Moon 2026
item.description: May 9, 2026 @ 5:00 pm - 9:00 pm - Get your tickets at Utahhumane.org/Bark / Sponsorship Opportunities The Humane Society of Utah invites you and your family, friends, and pups for a night of fun at the Gateway on May 9, 2026, 5-9 pm!
